keys.nextStyle: Next or previous style in the detail

start.title: How do you want to order?
start.intro: Three ways in, one draft: you can mix them before you send.
start.keeps: Choosing a way keeps what is already in the draft.

wayHint.pick: From your catalogue, with the whole size run in one grid.
wayHint.reorder: Copy a past order at today's prices; every difference is spelled out.
wayHint.upload: A spreadsheet for big size runs, checked row by row before anything is added.

start.draftsFailed: We could not read your drafts.

head.title: Order details
head.intro: What we need to process the request. Each field is saved when you leave it.
head.refHint: Your own number for this order: we print it on every document.
head.shipToHint: Addresses checked by us. A new one can be added here.
head.shipToWaiting: We check this new address before the first delivery. You can still send the request: we check it when we confirm.
head.shipToGone: This address is no longer in use: choose another one.
head.shipToNone: You have no delivery address yet: add one.
head.addAddressAdmin: Only your admin adds delivery addresses: ask {names}.
head.addAddressAdminNone: Only your admin adds delivery addresses.
head.dateHint: We confirm the date when we confirm the request.
head.noteHint: Anything we should know about this order.

problem.datePast: Choose today or a later day.

lines.emptyBody: Add a style, reorder a past order or upload a sheet.
lines.noteHint: Saved with the line; we see it on the request.

held.empty: A line asks at least one piece: type the sizes, or remove the line.

reorder.title: Reorder a past order
reorder.intro: Pick a past order, then the lines to copy. They come at today's prices, and every difference is written out before anything is added.
reorder.searchHint: Your PO or our order number
reorder.ordersFailed: We could not read your past orders.
reorder.orderFailed: We could not read this order.
reorder.todayPrices: Lines that can be copied are chosen already. A line with a discontinued colour can be chosen once you pick another colour.
reorder.noLines: This order has no lines to copy.

held.colour: Choose another colour first: this one is discontinued.
held.notAddable: This line cannot be copied: see what changed.

upload.title: Upload a sheet
upload.intro: One row per style, colour and size. We check every row first; nothing is added until you say so.
upload.templateHint: Columns: style, colour, size, quantity, your code.
upload.dropHint: CSV or Excel, at most 700 KB.
upload.unreadable: Check that the first row has the column names of the template, and try again.
upload.tooBig: The sheet is larger than 700 KB: split it in two.
upload.dryRun_one: This was a dry run: nothing is in your draft yet. The ready rows make {count} line.
upload.dryRun_other: This was a dry run: nothing is in your draft yet. The ready rows make {count} lines.
upload.nothingReady: No row is ready: fix the refused rows and upload the sheet again.
upload.cellProblem: The {column} cell could not be read.
upload.rowProblem: A cell of this row could not be read.

held.none: No row is ready to add.

summary.title: Summary
summary.netHint: At the prices of your price list shown on each line; VAT and shipping come with our confirmation.
summary.notice: This is a request. We confirm price, quantities and date within 1 working day; you will see it under Orders.
summary.pricesChanged_one: Prices changed since you started — {count} line
summary.pricesChanged_other: Prices changed since you started — {count} lines
summary.sendKeys: ⌘ Enter sends from here when nothing holds it.

problem.DATE_PAST: The requested delivery date has passed: choose today or a later day.
problem.SHIP_TO_ARCHIVED: The delivery address is no longer in use: choose another one.
problem.STYLE_NOT_SOLD: {style} is no longer sold to you: remove the line.
problem.PRICE_ANY: The price changed: take today's prices.

notice.PRICE_ANY: The price changed since that order
notice.REVISION_CHANGED: Now made to a newer revision of the style
notice.SIZES_DROPPED: Sizes no longer offered, left out: {sizes}
notice.SIZES_DROPPED_SOME: Some sizes are no longer offered and were left out
notice.MADE_TO_MEASURE: A made-to-measure unit is not reordered here: ask us
notice.NO_SIZES_LEFT: None of its sizes is offered any more
notice.back: {style}, {colour} is back in the draft at today's price.

done.merged: Size {size} added to the {style} line you had.
done.kept: Size {size} of {style} was on the draft already: your quantity was kept.

sent.title: Order request sent
sent.bodyNoDay: Our request {number}. We confirm within 1 working day.
sent.bodyRef: Your PO {ref}, our request {number}. We confirm by {day}.
sent.bodyRefNoDay: Your PO {ref}, our request {number}. We confirm within 1 working day.
sent.next: Until then you can follow it under Orders as To be confirmed by us.

closed.title: Request {number}
closed.SENT: This request was sent: we confirm it within 1 working day. To change it, withdraw it in Orders or ask us.
closed.ACCEPTED: We confirmed this request as order {order}.
closed.REFUSED: We did not accept this request: the reason is in Orders.

missing.title: This draft no longer exists
missing.body: It was sent or discarded, perhaps by a colleague. Start a new order or look under Orders.

draft.failed: We could not read this draft.
draft.stale: This draft changed elsewhere (a colleague, another tab). What you typed is still here.

address.title: New delivery address
address.check: We check new addresses before the first delivery. This order request can go to it at once: we check it when we confirm the request.
address.failed: The address was not accepted as it is. Check the fields and try again.

refused.province: An Italian address has its province: the two letters (MI, FI, BO…).
refused.field: We could not accept this field as it is: check it.

picker.title: Add styles
picker.subtitleStyles: Choose the styles: Space chooses a card, / searches.
picker.subtitleSizes: Type the pieces per colour and size: one line per colour.
picker.onDraft: {colour} is on line {seq} already: change its sizes there.
picker.gridCaption: Pieces by colour and size for {style}
picker.refused: These lines were not added as they are: a style or size may have changed. Read the styles again and check the sizes.

held.noPieces: Type the pieces of at least one colour.

discard.title: Discard this draft?
discard.noNumber: The draft was never sent: we never saw it.
discard.acknowledge: I understand: the draft and its lines are deleted.

catalogue.title: Catalogue
catalogue.failed: We could not read your catalogue.
catalogue.empty: No styles are open to you yet.
catalogue.emptyBody: Ask us: we open the styles you buy for your account.
catalogue.changed: Catalogue updated: prices or styles changed.

detail.failed: We could not read this style.
detail.missing: This style is not in your catalogue.
detail.sizeChartHeld: The size chart is not in the portal yet: ask us and we send it.
detail.docHeld: The public declaration page is not published yet: ask us and we send the declaration.
detail.later: Photos, care and user information, the minimum order and the lead time are not in the portal yet: ask us.

prices.none: Prices are not part of your access.

held.preview: This is a preview of the portal: nothing is saved.
held.offline: No connection: try again when you are back online.
held.mayNotOrder: Only colleagues who may order can start an order: ask your admin.

refusal.conflict: Someone changed this draft at the same time: read it again, then try once more.
refusal.invalid: That was not accepted as it is: check the line and try again.
refusal.forbidden: This is not part of your access.
refusal.notFound: This draft or line no longer exists.
refusal.rateLimited: Too many tries: wait a moment and try again.
refusal.unavailable: We could not reach the server: nothing was lost, try again.
refusal.other: Something went wrong on our side: nothing was lost, try again.

unsaved.what: Some of what you typed in the draft is not saved yet.

offline.title: No connection — showing what was loaded at {time}

noAccess.title: This page is not part of your access
noAccess.askAdmin: Ask your admin if you need it.
